name: You Can Vote at UNC-Chapel Hill
description: You Can Vote is a pro-democracy, nonpartisan, 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to increasing voter registration and turnout among North Carolinians facing barriers to full civic participation.

name: Young People's Alliance at UNC
description: We are a movement of students who are advocating for youth issues across North Carolina. We work on critical issues that empower young people and protect our democracy, like advocating for colleges to create Election Holidays to promote student voting.

name: Youth For Innocence at Carolina
description: Youth for Innocence at Carolina gathers youth volunteers within the UNC and local communities to examine wrongful conviction cases, primarily in North Carolina, and find new pathways to prove their innocence.

name: Youth Movement Against Alzheimer's
description: YMAA works to change the trajectory of Alzheimer’s disease through education, awareness, and collective action. We aim to reduce the stigma associated with Alzheimer’s disease by promoting disease education and supporting those affected.

name: Zankiliwa
description: Zankiliwa African Dance Team at UNC serves as a vibrant hub for the exploration and celebration of African dance and culture. Through rigorous training and captivating performances, the team aims to educate the campus and surrounding community.

name: Zeta Beta Tau
description: Zeta Beta Tau is a diverse fraternity of men who wish to commit themselves to the values of Service, Charity, Truth, Wisdom, Justice, and Brotherhood.

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority Inc - Omega Iota Chapter
description: Our organization seeks to foster the principles of scholarship, service, sisterly love, and finer womanhood among young college women through community service projects and informational programs.

name: Zeta Psi - Upsilon Chapter
description: The Upsilon Chapter of Zeta Psi was established at UNC in 1858. For over 150 years, Zetes have played an integral role in campus life and have maintained a close brotherhood as a social fraternity.

name: Zeta Tau Alpha
description: Passionate, courageous, loyal, and bright. The women of Zeta Tau Alpha are many things, but above all, we are sisters. Since 1979, Theta Tau has formed relationships, trained leaders, and introduced women to their forever friends.
